entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The applicant is facing trial in Case Crime No. 69 of 2022, under
Sections 376-D, 323, 506, 394, 411 I.P.C., Police Station- Etmadpur, District- Agra and he is in jail
since 07.03.2022 i.e. about 3 years and 6 months.
3.  According to status report dated 13.02.2025 of trial, two prosecution witnesses including victim have been examined and other witness is summoned through bailable warrant.
4. Learned counsel for applicant by referring the statement of victim submits that there are material contradiction and prosecution case has been substantially diluted.

sentences.text: 5. Per contra, learned A.G.A. for State submits that victim has remained consistent in her testimony and made specific allegation against applicant.

6. In the aforesaid circumstances, taking note of nature of evidence, specifically the statement of victim, I am of the opinion that no case is made out for bail at this stage, however, while rejecting the prayer for bail, it is observed that in case, trial is not concluded within 8 months, applicant will have liberty to approach this Court or Trial Court as advised along with status report of trial.
7. Accordingly, bail application is disposed of with aforesaid observation.
